actionability.justification: The rule gives a concrete behavioral change (deliver exactly the requested scope, surface extras as suggestions instead of adding them) that is directly checkable against future outputs.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: It generalizes to any scope-bounded request rather than just one-file notes, and stays concrete ("no extra files, demos, or unrequested additions") instead of collapsing into a vague platitude like "stay on task."

leakage.justification: The remedy text is written generically, though the parenthetical example "just a one-file note" is lifted almost verbatim from the incident quote rather than being a fully generic illustration.

routing_fitness.justification: The rationale correctly rules out skill (no multi-step procedure) and hook (scope creep isn't mechanically detectable pre-action) and lands on a one-line claude-md rule, which is the cheapest adequate remedy type for this failure mode.

trigger_quality.justification: As a claude-md standing rule rather than a skill it isn't held to a formal "Use when..." trigger, but its situational cue ("when the user specifies scope") is still loosely bounded and leaves "specifies scope" open to interpretation.
